title: Elodie and the Winter
author: N. M. Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Vane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
